params.message:
Count sheets Bouwsoft already has as typed in; hide 0/0

The "x/y ingevoerd in Bouwsoft" line on Dagrapport counted only sheets
the office marked by hand, while each card already shows when the
nightly sync found the worker's hours in Bouwsoft. The count now
includes those, so it matches what Bouwsoft holds. On a day with no
handed-in sheets the line read 0/0 and said nothing; it is now left out.
